policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="requestedModel" value="@{
            try {
                var body = context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true);
                return body?["model"]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
            } catch (Exception) {
                return string.Empty;
            }
        }" />
        
        
            <when condition="@{
                var requested = (string)context.Variables["requestedModel"];
                var allowed = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("allowedModels", string.Empty).Split(',').Select(m => m.Trim()).ToArray();
                return requested.Length == 0 || !allowed.Any(m => m == requested);
            }">
                
                    
                    
                        application/json
                    
                    {"error":{"code":"model_not_allowed","message":"The contract of this key does not allow the requested model."}}
